items_addressed: Claim box per D1-opus, conditions as antecedents, a tag on every sentence: the boundary error restricted to what can be divided; compounding prices standing in the general form, including the fixed-prize and proportional-prize-without-provision-or-diffusion conditions; 'each actor computes correctly; only a change in what winning confers removes it' (Adv-O I2, moved up from 12.2); onegroup stated exactly ('however carriers are grouped, selection does not favour what benefits all'). 'Every forward-looking actor' and 'manufactures' removed everywhere

blind (Lemma 3.3): (2) is now neutrality among compliers, which needs equal incidence, and unequal incidence re-sorts compliers. (3) is now compliance, per type: within a type, evasion grows iff c_k > F̄_k, and compliance prevails if F̄_k > c_k for every type that can evade, whatever the incidence. The falling-sanction case has its endpoint conditions F̄(0)>c>F̄(1) and both one-sided cases. The Scope notes that the converse fails across types (Codex 5). The prose says 'equal incidence keeps a rule from becoming a weapon': unequal incidence is a barrier to entry, the second direction of capture, pointing to 4.1
load: 'other advantages equal' put in the headline; the second part carries 'all phi_k equal'
twochan kept verbatim. The Test Γ observable 1+θ (the response of intensity to shared loss over its response to private cost) is in 3.4 and in S3 [num: SP(G)]

boundary (3.6): (8) split into divisible and positional parts (κ ∈ [0,n−1), κ_s ∈ [−1,0]), and the contest prize split into Ω_e+Ω_s. (2) weighs divisible payoffs by κ and positional ones by κ_s, and relative concern toward the positional part is accurate. Schaffer 1988 and Hehenkamp et al. 2004 cited as D4 M2 asks. A realist paragraph (Grieco 1988; Powell 1991) says the positional answer is to keep positional prizes from forming, pointing to 10.2. Convergence [conj] restricted to the divisible part

standprice (3.9): titled 'Compounding prices standing' and tagged [thm∣prem]. General form (9) in λ_rel and λ_com, with 'whatever θ0' (narrows iff λ_rel>λ_com). (1) fixed prize on 0≤Γ_δ<1, narrowing even where equal standing is stable, θ_Γ → −1. (2) proportional prize: narrows iff (1−β)r>1, over every horizon, which is also the instability condition. The Scope carries net payoff as load-bearing [num SP], the cusp at Γ_δ≥1 [thm; num PD], diffusion separating the thresholds (S3.2) [num SP], and the strategic case: the price elasticity of 2.2(4), 2(n−1)/n, 1.05–7.9, laggard to zero, catch-up reversal [num MP] (Harris–Vickers; Konrad–Kovenock). Corrected V6.1's 'the weight of a rebated levy and the gain from breaking a promise move with Γ_δ' to the right signs: host and point of enough recede, levy and promise-breaking weigh more (both memos had this wrong)

Powell 1991 paragraph extended by the common channel. Added 'the loop selects at both ends' (D1-fable 2.1) and the levers inside the actor (common-return growth widens the self, decisiveness narrows it, fixed or positional stakes add to the relative return, provision lowers it) [num SP(H)]

twoerrors (new Remark 3.10, after standprice), per D1-opus 2.5: the held error, which understanding corrects, against the working objective, which is correct for each and self-defeating for all. Threshold nκ/((n−1)(1+κ)) = 0.381 [thm; num SP(I)]. 'Judge the game, not the act' made exact; points to 12.2

onegroup (3.11 now): the total and every within-group term are ≤0 under every payoff-monotone rule; the between-group term is ≤0 under affine fitness and otherwise can be positive without making the total positive (D2-fable 8). Headline corrected to 'selected against overall and within every group'. S3 proof uses Chebyshev and Jensen, and its numerics are extended with nonlinear fitness [num PR]

club (3.12 now) kept as a full statement in the core, because Part III (§9 R7) and §5 cite it (plan's side-result rule overrides D1-opus 'M to one sentence'). Symbols renamed m → m_o and s → n_b; 'every result stated for that contest holds among blocs'

psi: 'individually rational, collectively self-defeating, and false as a doctrine about nature', each part argued: individually rational via Remark twoerrors and Alchian; collectively self-defeating via 3.6(1), 3.7, 3.4; false via 3.6(2), evolution, Henrich scoped to persons with firms and states shaped by selection on conduct, Ψ3's laws as parameters (2.3), and the values. 'Partly made true' gains the MPE multiplicity, labelled [num: MP; held for outside review], with the belief reading as [conj]

§3.8 opens with Ren's ruling, quoted in Chinese with [corpus: possibility-space] (verified in keep-the-possibility-space-open README, 2026-10-03), followed by the mechanism it compresses (2.3(2), 3.5(5), 3.3) and 'the premise is the race's own; the conclusion is the opposite'

Corpus keys corrected: 讲理/讲赢 → [corpus: alignment-selection; jian-and-wenyan] with the full original line (verified, item 32 and items 53/113); five endgames → [corpus: selfishness-spiral] (verified, item 95); the polycentric sample-size hedge keyed to selfishness-spiral; 'winner takes all, winner justifies all' keyed to selfishness-spiral; 局部胜出 line → meta-attractor (verified, item 107)
